function.arguments:
{"claim_id": "c2", "code": "import torch, json, sys, struct
sys.path.insert(0, "/root/cases/case_166")
import kernel as K

vals = []
for bits in range(0x0000, 0x10000):
    v = struct.unpack('<e', struct.pack('<H', bits))[0]
    if v == v and abs(v) != float('inf') and v > -1:
        vals.append(v)
x = torch.tensor(vals, dtype=torch.float16).to("cuda")
out = K.run(x)
ref = torch.log1p(x.to(torch.float64)).to("cuda")
err = (out.to(torch.float64) - ref).abs()
viol = (err > 1e-6)
vx = x[viol]
ve = err[viol]
# exponent of u = 1+x in FP32
u = (1.0 + vx.to(torch.float32)).to(torch.float64)
exps = torch.floor(torch.log2(u)).to(torch.int32).tolist()
res = {
 "metric": "enumerate all domain-wide tolerance violations, classify by exponent of u",
 "n_violations": int(viol.sum().item()),
 "violating_x": vx.tolist(),
 "violating_err": ve.tolist(),
 "violating_exponents": exps,
 "max_abs_err": err.max().item(),
 "tolerance": 1e-6,
 "n_exponent_ge_10": sum(1 for e in exps if e >= 10),
}
print(json.dumps(res))
", "expected_signal": "violating inputs concentrated at large exponents (u>=1024) indicating FP32 summation rounding accumulation"}
